paragraphs.text:
The vase hits you squarely in the chest, shattering on impact. 
The broken shards fly around you, some cutting your flesh. You 
are knocked off balance and tumble to the floor.

Seizing this opportunity, Amelia runs out the door as fast as 
her legs will carry her, calling for help as she does so.

You could chase after her, or you could take this opportunity 
to explore the empty house. The choice is yours.
• To explore the house, go to 7.
• To chase after Amelia, go to 141.
